focusProposals.name: Select or identify a fronted preposition before which or whom in a formal relative clause
focusProposals.boundary: Recognition of the relative-clause construction and the required preposition. A supplied whom is not evidence of independently choosing whom.

focusProposals.name: Select or identify a fronted preposition in a formal wh-question
focusProposals.boundary: Recognition of a formal fronted-preposition question. Does not establish independent question production.

focusProposals.name: Select a past-form hypothetical condition with a would-result clause
focusProposals.boundary: Recognition of paired second-conditional forms, including could in the condition. Does not establish independent conditional writing.

focusProposals.name: Select conventional container and partitive noun combinations
focusProposals.boundary: Selection among the supplied noun combinations; the task does not establish productive collocation use.

focusProposals.name: Recognise technical vocabulary from verbal definitions
focusProposals.boundary: Recognising the English term given a concept definition. Does not establish independent writing or mathematical mastery.

focusProposals.name: Match technical vocabulary to a pictured object or labelled part
focusProposals.boundary: Matching the English term to an accessible diagram. Does not establish independent writing or geometric reasoning.

focusProposals.name: Select regarding to introduce the topic of a statement
focusProposals.boundary: Topic framing is distinct from addition, sequence, contrast or causal inference. The atomic parent requires review.

focusProposals.name: Select indeed or in fact to reinforce a preceding statement
focusProposals.boundary: Recognition of a confirming discourse marker; does not demonstrate composing a coherent argument.

focusProposals.name: Select a phrase introducing an inference from supplied evidence
focusProposals.boundary: A cautious inference must be supported by the stated evidence. Absence of evidence alone is not evidence that a hypothesis is false.

focusProposals.name: Select in other words to introduce a restatement
focusProposals.boundary: Recognition of paraphrase/restatement, not contrast or an unrelated additional event.

focusProposals.name: Interpret did not need to as lack of necessity without determining whether the action occurred
focusProposals.boundary: The uncontextualised sentence alone does not establish whether the action occurred. Preserve the already correct answer key.

focusProposals.name: Select asked plus object plus to-infinitive to report a polite request
focusProposals.boundary: Reporting a request is distinct from backshifting a declarative statement. Preserve the already correct answer key.
